Part 2&3 物品 OBJECTS

Describe something important that has been kept in your family for a long time

描述一件家里长期保存的重要物品

⚠️ AI 范例，仅供学习 — IELTS 口语全程独立完成，背诵照搬 AI 答案会被考官识别为背稿。

Part 2 话题卡片

Describe something important that has been kept in your family for a long time

  • What it is (它是什么)
  • When your family had it (你们家什么时候有的)
  • How your family got it (你们家是怎么得到的)
  • And explain why it is important to your family (并解释为什么它对你们家很重要)

问题与答案

Cue CardDescribe something important that has been kept in your family for a long time

I'd like to talk about a box of old family photos, which my parents have kept for as long as I can remember. It's not valuable in terms of money, but it means a lot to us. First of all, what it is: it's a worn cardboard box full of printed photos, most of them taken before I was born. There are pictures of my grandparents when they were young, my parents' wedding, and a lot of shots of me and my brother as little kids, some of them faded and slightly yellowed. As for when we got it, my parents started collecting these photos in the 1990s, before digital cameras existed. They used to take the film to a shop to be developed, and they kept every print in this box. I remember my mum telling me that the box has moved with us every time we changed homes, which is why it's still in one piece. The reason it's important to my family is that it carries our childhood memories. Whenever relatives come to visit, we open the box together and look through the photos, and everyone starts telling stories about the past. For me, those pictures are a bridge to my childhood, they remind me of the summers I spent at my grandparents' house and the people who are no longer with us. Looking back, I think this box is one of the few things in our home that money can't replace, because it holds the history of our whole family.

讲的是家里一盒老照片，爸妈保存了很久。它不值钱但对我们意义重大。它是装满了打印照片的旧纸盒，大多是出生前拍的：爷爷奶奶年轻时的照片、爸妈的结婚照、我和弟弟小时候的照片，有些已经褪色发黄。爸妈从 90 年代开始收集，那时还没有数码相机，胶卷拿去店里冲洗，每张都收进这个盒子；搬家几次盒子都跟着走。它重要是因为承载着儿时回忆：亲戚来访时一起翻照片讲故事，对我来说这些照片是通往童年的桥，让我想起在爷爷奶奶家度过的夏天和已经不在的人。这是家里用钱换不来的东西，装着全家人的历史。

Q2What things do families keep for a long time?

Generally speaking, families tend to keep things that carry memories or practical value. Photos, letters and jewellery are common, because they remind people of important moments and loved ones. Some families also keep furniture or tools that have been passed down, especially if they were handmade or expensive. I think the common thread is that these objects connect people to their past, which is why they're hard to throw away.

家庭一般会保存承载回忆或有实用价值的东西：照片、信件、首饰很常见，因为它们让人想起重要时刻和亲人；有些家庭还保存传下来的家具或工具，尤其是手工制作或昂贵的。共同点是这些物品把人和过去连在一起，所以舍不得扔。

Q3What's the difference between things valued by people in the past and today?

Compared with the past, the things people value have changed quite a lot. In the past, objects were often kept because they were rare or expensive, like a watch or a piece of furniture, and people repaired things instead of replacing them. Nowadays, most products are cheap and easy to buy, so people tend to value experiences and digital memories more, like photos on their phones. That said, I think the emotional value of certain items, like family photos, hasn't really changed.

和过去相比，人们看重的东西变化很大。过去物品常因稀有或昂贵而被保存，比如手表、家具，东西坏了会修而不是换；现在产品便宜易得，人们更看重体验和数字记忆，比如手机里的照片。不过某些物品的情感价值，比如家庭照片，其实没怎么变。

Q4What kinds of things are kept in museums?

Museums usually keep objects that have historical, cultural or artistic value. For example, ancient pottery, paintings, old documents and traditional costumes are all common exhibits. Some museums also display everyday items from the past, like old tools or household goods, which help visitors understand how people lived. I think the purpose is to preserve things that would otherwise be lost, so future generations can see and learn from them.

博物馆通常保存有历史、文化或艺术价值的物品：古代陶器、绘画、旧文献、传统服饰都是常见展品；有些博物馆还展出过去的日常用品，如旧工具、家用物品，帮助参观者了解当时人们的生活。目的是保存那些否则会消失的东西，让后代能看到和学习。

Q5What's the influence of technology on museums?

Technology has changed museums in quite positive ways. Many museums now use screens, audio guides and even virtual reality to make exhibits more engaging, so visitors can see how ancient buildings looked or how people lived. Technology also makes museums more accessible, since people can take virtual tours online without travelling. Having said that, I don't think technology replaces the real objects, it just makes the experience richer and easier to understand.

科技给博物馆带来了相当积极的变化。很多博物馆用屏幕、语音导览甚至虚拟现实让展品更有吸引力，参观者能看到古代建筑的样子或人们的生活；科技也让博物馆更容易接近，人们不用出门就能在线虚拟参观。不过科技不会取代真实展品，只是让体验更丰富、更容易理解。

Q6What are the benefits of technology for learning history?

I think technology makes history much easier to learn. With videos, 3D models and online archives, students can see historical events and objects in a vivid way, instead of just reading about them in textbooks. For example, a 3D model of an ancient city is far more memorable than a written description. Technology also allows people to access historical materials from anywhere, which means learning history is no longer limited to the classroom.

科技让学历史容易得多。通过视频、3D 模型和在线档案，学生能生动地看到历史事件和文物，而不是只读课本；比如古代城市的 3D 模型比文字描述好记得多。科技还让人随时随地获取历史资料，学历史不再局限于教室。

Q7Why do people visit museums?

People visit museums for different reasons. Some go to learn about history and culture, because museums present information in a reliable and organised way. Others go for entertainment, especially when museums hold special exhibitions or interactive displays. In my country, many young people also visit museums to take photos and share them online. I think the main attraction is that museums offer both knowledge and experience in one place.

人们去博物馆的原因各不相同。有人为了了解历史和文化，因为博物馆以可靠、有条理的方式呈现信息；有人为了娱乐，尤其是特展或互动展览；国内很多年轻人还去拍照发网上。主要吸引力是博物馆把知识和体验放在了一起。
